_help: Go-live settings (workstream C). Empty value = that feature stays off. After editing, commit; the site rebuilds in ~2 min.
_domain_help: Set to saubag.in only AFTER the DNS records are in place (see GOLIVE.md). Empty = site stays on github.io.
_contact_help: Shown on the Privacy and Takedown pages. Those two pages are not published until this is filled in.
_affiliate_help: url_template wraps every outgoing product link. {url} = product URL, {url_enc} = URL-encoded product URL. per_brand overrides it for one brand (exact brand name as on the site). Leave both empty = links go straight to the brand.
_analytics_help: provider: cloudflare (id = beacon token), ga4 (id = G-XXXX), goatcounter (id = your code). Empty = no analytics.
